name: openhire
summary: MCP server + CLI: job postings with the employer's real posting date, pulled from Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby / Workable / SmartRecruiters / Workday / Beisen / Moka ATS APIs and first-party career sites. Employers in AI infra, autonomous driving and embodied AI; HR and recruiting roles have their own family. Works from mainland China (CNB mirror). Free job-search checklist with anti-scam steps. Résumés never leave your device.
author: OpenHire
